After that, go to BarnesandNoble.com and find one Pokémon card item that’s clearly in stock, open the actual product page so I can see the listing itself, and grab the title and listed price. Then head to Walmart.com, search for a Pokémon card product, and make sure the one you pick is sold and shipped by Walmart rather than a marketplace seller, then record the product name and price and leave that product page open too. Once you’ve got those pages, compare the in-stock options across all three stores and tell me which available item is the cheapest overall and where I should buy it. Then, make the tab for this option active.
